official.deadline_note: There is only one application deadline each year. If you miss the application deadline you can only apply one year later; applications are not accepted after the deadline.
official.status_note: The published call on the Apply page is for 2026/2027 and its application deadline of 15 January 2026 has passed. The cycle expected the student to find their programme from November to December 2025, contact their sending partner, submit by 15 January 2026, receive nomination by the end of February 2026, sit entrance exams between March and May 2026, and hear the result by the end of June or beginning of July 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The about page states scholarship holders 'who start their full degree scholarship studies ... in Hungary are required to attend tuition-free education'.
benefits: Monthly stipend of HUF 43,700 for non-degree, bachelor's, master's and one-tier master's level programmes, for 12 months a year until completion of studies
Monthly stipend of HUF 140,000 for the first phase of doctoral education (4 semesters) and HUF 180,000 for the second phase (4 semesters), for 12 months a year until completion of studies
Accommodation support as a free dormitory place or an additional contribution to accommodation costs of HUF 40,000 per month
Tuition-free education at a Hungarian higher education institution
Health care services under the relevant Hungarian legislation and supplementary medical insurance for up to HUF 65,000 a year per person
eligibility: You must be nominated by your sending partner; only nominated applicants can proceed
Only programmes supported by the cooperation agreement between Hungary and your country or region can be applied for
Entrance examination scores must be a minimum of 56 out of 100 for the application to be considered for the final list of awardees

Self-financed students registered at a Hungarian higher education institution at the time of the deadline may apply only if recommended by their host university and if their corrected credit average exceeds the average performance of that study programme
Scholarship holders must habitually reside in Hungary during the study period

requirements: Hold at least a bachelor's degree or the qualification required for the chosen programme level, as set out in the Call for Applications
Contact your sending partner, which can be the local Hungarian Embassy, related ministry or council, since each has its own deadlines and requirements
Submit the application in the online application system with the documents listed in section 3.2 of the Call for Applications
Scholarship holders starting in or after the fall semester of 2020 must complete a compulsory Hungarian as a foreign language and culture course provided free of charge by the host institution
Scholarship holders must earn at least eighteen credits on the average of the last two semesters with uninterrupted student status
documents: Statement for Application, uploaded to the online application system
Documents listed in section 3.2 of the Call for Applications, which vary by level of study and nationality
Mandatory medical certificate on the official template of satisfactory health condition, issued and signed by a physician
Academic and language certificates, with the possibility in certain cases to submit them later according to section 3.3 of the Call for Applications
Supervisor statement where required by the proposed Doctoral School, by 15 March 2026
Scan of a national ID card and a signed declaration that a valid passport will be uploaded by 1 August

selection_criteria: Nomination by the sending partner by the end of February
Entrance examination at the Hungarian higher education institution between March and May, with a minimum of 56 out of 100 points required
Evaluation of the application documents and exam results by Tempus Public Foundation
coverage: Tuition-free education at the host institution
Monthly stipend of HUF 43,700 for bachelor's, master's and one-tier master's programmes, for 12 months a year until completion
Doctoral stipend of HUF 140,000 for the first four semesters and HUF 180,000 for the second four semesters
Accommodation as either a free dormitory place or a contribution of HUF 40,000 per month
Supplementary medical insurance for up to HUF 65,000 a year per person

The programme states that these provisions are a contribution to the living expenses of a single student and do not fully cover all the costs of living, so students need to add their own financial resources
application_method: Find the chosen programme, checking available study fields by partner country on the website or in the DreamApply system
Contact your sending partner from November and ask about its exact deadlines and requirements
Register in the online application system at apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu and upload the required documents, choosing only two programme priorities
Ensure you are nominated by the sending partner, then sit the entrance examination between March and May
official.application_route: Apply online through apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu with a nomination from your sending partner; the office forwards nominated applications to the Hungarian institutions.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must come from a country or region with a valid cooperation agreement with Hungary; the Call for Applications lists the eligible countries and the study fields offered to each
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme is for foreign students and is limited to countries and study fields covered by Hungary's cooperation agreements
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Only study programmes supported by the cooperation agreement between Hungary and the applicant's country or region, as listed in the Call for Applications annexes
official.duration: Duration of the chosen study programme; full-degree holders may extend the scholarship period by a total of two semesters, while partial studies, doctoral programmes, preparatory courses and specialisation courses cannot be extended
official.description: Stipendium Hungaricum is a scholarship programme for foreign students founded by the Hungarian Government in 2013 and managed by Tempus Public Foundation, under the supervision of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade. It awards tuition-free education at a Hungarian higher education institution together with a monthly stipend, an accommodation contribution in the form of a free dormitory place or HUF 40,000 per month, and supplementary medical insurance. At bachelor's, master's and one-tier master's level the monthly stipend is HUF 43,700, while doctoral scholarship holders receive HUF 140,000 in the first four semesters and HUF 180,000 in the second four semesters.
official.program_type: Government scholarship programme managed by Tempus Public Foundation

applicant_utility.summary: Stipendium Hungaricum is a government award run by Tempus Public Foundation, and the application does not go through a Hungarian university at all: you register at apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu, and only nominated applications proceed. Your first job is therefore to find your sending partner, usually the Hungarian embassy or the relevant ministry in your country, because it can run its own earlier deadline and your application dies without its nomination. Once you are through, the award covers tuition plus HUF 43,700 a month for twelve months of the year at bachelor's, master's and one-tier master's level, plus either a free dormitory place or a HUF 40,000 monthly accommodation contribution, and up to HUF 65,000 a year of supplementary medical insurance. Read the fine print before you budget: the programme says this is only a contribution to living expenses and does not cover all of them, and scholarship holders must live in Hungary, because the living and housing allowances stop if you are abroad for more than 30 days.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Doctoral degree holders and undergraduate applicants from countries with a Hungarian cooperation agreement who need tuition plus a modest monthly allowance and can cover the remaining cost of living in Hungary.
application_readiness_checklist: Check the partner-country page for your country and list the study fields actually offered to you
Contact your sending partner as early as possible, since its nomination is mandatory and it may have an earlier deadline
Prepare in the DreamApply system and choose only two programme priorities that match your field of studies
Gather the documents required by section 3.2 of the Call for Applications for your level and nationality
Ask a physician to complete the mandatory medical certificate on the official template
If the programme is doctoral, initiate the supervisor statement early where the Doctoral School requires it
Plan for the compulsory Hungarian as a foreign language course, since not passing it can cost you part of the monthly stipend
common_rejection_risks: Missing your sending partner's own deadline or failing to secure nomination at all
Applying for a study field not covered by the cooperation agreement with your country
Treating the scholarship as full living support when the programme itself says it is only a contribution
Being absent from Hungary for more than 30 consecutive days, which suspends the living and housing allowances
Falling below the eighteen-credit average over the last two semesters, which can lead to termination
Applying through an agency, which the programme warns against since cooperation is direct with the sending partner
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The programme states it provides a contribution only, so the part of rent, food and transport above a dormitory place or HUF 40,000 a month, plus anything above HUF 43,700 a month in living expenses, is your own.
document_audit: You can submit with a national ID card and a signed declaration that the passport follows by 1 August, so a missing passport is not fatal
Language and school certificates can in certain cases be submitted later, under section 3.3 of the Call for Applications
Keep the nomination correspondence from your sending partner as evidence, since only nominated applications proceed
alerts: The published 2026/2027 deadline of 15 January 2026 has passed; there is one deadline per year and no applications are accepted afterwards
Self-funded students at Hungarian institutions may apply only with a host-university recommendation and a corrected credit average above the programme average
You may change institution, programme or study language only once per study level and only within one year of beginning the studies
The Hungarian language course is compulsory for full-time bachelor and master holders who started in or after fall 2020
The scholarship holder must reside in Hungary habitually and report absences longer than ten working days
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Find your programme, contact the sending partner, register in the online system and upload documents by the annual deadline, wait for nomination, sit the institution's entrance examination, then receive the result from Tempus Public Foundation.
